title: Hue City Tour with Dragon Boat – Thien Mu, Imperial City, Royal Tombs & Incense Village
start_location: Hotel pick-up in Hue city centre
organizers: Daily Tours; Hue city tour
meta_description: Hue city tour with dragon boat: Perfume River, Thien Mu, Imperial City, Dong Ba Market, Minh Mang and Khai Dinh tombs, incense village.
content:
This Hue city tour with dragon boat starts and ends at your hotel in Hue. Cruise the Perfume River by dragon boat to Thien Mu Pagoda, explore the Imperial City and Dong Ba Market, have lunch with royal tea and an herbal foot bath, then visit the tombs of Minh Mang and Khai Dinh and the incense and conical hat village of Thuy Xuan.
## Highlights of the Hue city tour with dragon boat
- Dragon boat: a peaceful ride on the Perfume River
- Thien Mu Pagoda: the oldest pagoda in Hue
- Hue Imperial City: where the Nguyen kings, Vietnam’s last royal dynasty, lived, worked and worshipped
- Royal tombs: Minh Mang’s traditional architecture and Khai Dinh’s blend of Vietnamese and French styles
- Thuy Xuan village: traditional conical hats and colourful incense
Aerial view of the Hue Imperial City and its moat. Photo: Gaodanielbo / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0
Complex of Hue Monuments is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Ngo Mon (Meridian Gate) of the Hue Imperial City. Photo: Francisco Anzola / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0

- Pick-up 8:00–8:30 AM at your hotel in Hue, back at about 4:30 PM
## What is included in the Hue city tour with dragon boat

title: Hoi An ATV Tour – Off-Road Quad Bike Adventure in the Countryside with BBQ
start_location: Hotel pick-up in Hoi An
organizers: Daily Tours
meta_description: Hoi An ATV tour: 5 hours with safety briefing, 1.5–2 hours of off-road quad biking through villages and jungle, and a BBQ meal.
content:
This Hoi An ATV tour is a 5-hour off-road quad bike adventure in the countryside. After a safety briefing at an organic farm, ride for 1.5 to 2 hours through traditional villages, rice paddies, muddy trails and jungle with professional instructors, then enjoy a BBQ lunch or dinner.
## Highlights of the Hoi An ATV tour
- Organic farm: a scenic 50-minute drive from your hotel
- Safety briefing: ATV instructions and a waiver before the ride
- Off-road ride: 1.5–2 hours through villages, rice paddies, local farms and jungle
- Photo stops: muddy jungle roads and wide views on the way back
- BBQ meal: steaks, chicken and grilled vegetables; vegetarian and vegan options
Quad bike splashing through a muddy trail. Photo: josefotoquad / Flickr, CC CC0 1.0
Hoi An Ancient Town is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

title: Hoi An to Hue Jeep Tour – Hai Van Pass, Lang Co & Ghost City (One Way)
start_location: Hotel pick-up in Hoi An (or Hue)
organizers: Daily Tours; Hue city tour
meta_description: Hoi An to Hue jeep tour, one way: Bang An Tower, Hai Van Pass, Suoi Mo spring, Lang Co seafood lunch and Hue's Ghost City.
content:
This Hoi An to Hue jeep tour turns the transfer between the two cities into a day out, one way in either direction. Ride a jeep about 165 km past a 1,000-year-old Champa tower, over the Hai Van Pass and around Lap An Lagoon, with a spring bath, a seafood lunch at Lang Co and a stop at the “Ghost City” before Hue.
## Highlights of the Hoi An to Hue jeep tour
- Bang An Tower: a 1,000-year-old Champa temple and its Hindu beliefs
- Hai Van Pass: clouds, winding roads and views, with coffee at the top
- Suoi Mo and Lap An Lagoon: a refreshing spring bath and a poetic lagoon
- Lang Co Bay: lunch at a local seafood restaurant
- Tu Hien Bridge and the Ghost City: jeep photos and unusual tomb architecture
Old fortification and coastal view at the top of the Hai Van Pass. Photo: archer10 (Dennis) / Flickr, CC BY-SA 2.0
Complex of Hue Monuments is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Read more about the Hai Van Pass.
Ornate tombs of An Bang village, the “Ghost City” near Hue. Photo: Prince Roy / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0

title: Cham Island Snorkeling Tour – Speedboat, Fishing Village & Seafood Lunch
start_location: Hotel pick-up in Hoi An city
organizers: Daily Tours
meta_description: Cham Island snorkeling tour from Hoi An: speedboat, Marine Protected Area, Hai Tang Pagoda, fishing village, snorkeling and seafood.
content:
This Cham Island snorkeling tour takes you by speedboat from Cua Dai harbour to the islands off Hoi An. Visit the Marine Protected Area, the boat shelter, Hai Tang Pagoda and the traditional fishing village, snorkel for about 45 minutes, then relax on the beach with a local-style seafood lunch.
## Highlights of the Cham Island snorkeling tour
- Speedboat: a breezy ride from Cua Dai harbour
- Lang Beach: the Marine Protected Area, the boat shelter, Hai Tang Pagoda and a fishing village
- Snorkeling: about 45 minutes in the water
- Beach time: swimming at Bai Ong eco zone or Bai Chong beach
- Seafood lunch: local-style seafood
Colourful corals and fish on a tropical reef. Photo: NOAA Photo Library / Flickr, CC BY 2.0
Read more about the Cu Lao Cham Marine Park.
Green hills and coastline of the Cham Islands (Cu Lao Cham). Photo: Original uploaded by Lê Thy (Transfered by Phó Nháy) / Wikimedia Commons, Public domain

title: Tra Que Cooking Class – Bike, Farming, Herbal Massage & Vegetable Village Lunch
start_location: Hotel pick-up in Hoi An city (by bicycle)

meta_description: Tra Que cooking class by bike: market, farming in Tra Que, herbal foot massage and a 5-dish cooking lesson with lunch.

Visit a market to learn about everyday and medicinal vegetables, ride through rice fields to Tra Que Vegetable Village, try organic farming in a farmer’s outfit, relax with an herbal massage, then learn to cook five local dishes for lunch.

- Countryside ride: rice fields, buffaloes, cows and farmers at work
- Tra Que farming: E water, a conical hat and traditional organic farming
- Herbal massage: head, shoulders and feet, with fresh garden herbs
- Cooking class: vegetable carving and five local dishes; vegetarian menu on request

start_location: Hotel pick-up in Hoi An

- Rice paper: learn how it is made and try it yourself
- Woven mats: a colourful craft passed down through generations
- Basket boat: row a thung chai along the coconut-lined river

- E water: a local drink made from Tra Que herbs
- Lantern making: make your own lantern with local craftsmen

meta_description: Hue day tour from Hoi An or Da Nang: Hai Van Pass, Lang Co, Khai Dinh Tomb, Imperial City, Thien Mu Pagoda and Hue lunch.
content:
This Hue day tour from Hoi An (or from Da Nang) crosses the scenic Hai Van Pass to the former royal capital. On the way you stop at Lap An Lagoon and Lang Co Beach, then visit Khai Dinh Tomb, have a Hue-style lunch, explore the Imperial City and finish at Thien Mu Pagoda before driving back.
## Highlights of the Hue day tour from Hoi An
- Hai Van Pass: a 21 km mountain pass on National Route 1A between Da Nang and Hue, one of Vietnam’s most scenic roads
- Lap An Lagoon and Lang Co Beach: more than 10 km of white sand and clear blue water
- Khai Dinh Tomb: a royal tomb blending Eastern art and Western architecture
- Hue Imperial City: Ngo Mon Gate, the Royal Library, Thai Hoa Palace and the Nine Dynastic Urns
- Thien Mu Pagoda: closely linked to Hue’s culture and history
Aerial view of the Hue Imperial City and its moat. Photo: Gaodanielbo / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0
Complex of Hue Monuments is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

meta_description: L'Amour Cruise, 2 days 1 night in Ha Long Bay: Sung Sot Cave, Titop Island, Luon Cave, a four-season mineral pool and rooftop dinner.
content:
The L’Amour Cruise is a 2 days 1 night trip in Ha Long Bay from Tuan Chau International Port. The ship is named after Hon Trong Mai (Fighting Cock Islet), a symbol of lasting love, and is decorated in an Indochine style.
## Highlights of the L’Amour Cruise trip
- Cabins and suites: 33 in five categories from 26 to 75 m²; higher categories add a large balcony, an outdoor hot tub and a salt sauna room.
- Sung Sot Cave: visited on the first afternoon.
- Titop Island: swim, or hike to the peak for a panoramic view.
- Luon Cave: by bamboo boat or kayak on the second morning.
- Food: lunch at Hoa Lu restaurant, dinner at Thang Long rooftop restaurant, breakfast and an early lunch.
- Evening: canapé afternoon tea and Happy Hour or a cooking class, a traditional music performance, squid fishing or the four-season mineral pool.
- Morning: sunrise viewing and a Vovinam martial arts class.
Four-season mineral pool
For travellers comparing Ha Long Bay luxury cruises, this ship adds cultural touches such as traditional music to the classic cave and island route. The 2 day 1 night Halong Bay cruise includes an English and Vietnamese speaking guide. The Ha Long Bay – Cat Ba Archipelago is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

meta_description: La Casta Regal Cruise, 2 days 1 night in Lan Ha Bay: balcony suites, kayaking at Ba Trai Dao and Tra Bau, Jacuzzi and Tai Chi.
content:
The La Casta Regal Cruise is a 2 days 1 night trip through Ha Long Bay and Lan Ha Bay on a ship with only 24 cabins, each at least 28 m² with a panoramic ocean view and a private balcony.
## Highlights of the La Casta Regal Cruise trip
- Suites: Junior, Senior, Family and VIP (Honeymoon) suites, with shower and bathtub.
- Ba Trai Dao: the three islets and natural lagoon of Lan Ha Bay, with kayaking and swimming. In bad weather this stop may be replaced by the Dark and Bright Cave.
- Tra Bau area: known as a filming location of the movie King Kong; free kayaking or swimming on the second morning.
- Food: lunch, a dinner of seafood and Vietnamese cuisine, breakfast and brunch.
- Sunset: party and Happy Hour at the bar (buy two, get one free on selected drinks), plus a cooking demonstration.
- Evening and morning: squid fishing and karaoke, then Tai Chi on the sundeck at sunrise.
- On board: an outdoor hot tub, spa services and WiFi.
Aerial view

title: Cao Bang Motorbike Tour 2 Nights 1 Day
start_location: Hà Nội
organizers: Tour Tay Bac - Sapa - Ha Giang; TOURS & PACKGES
meta_description: Cao Bang motorbike tour from Hanoi in 2 nights 1 day: Ban Gioc Waterfall, Nguom Ngao Cave and Ngoc Con Valley with a local guide and meals.
content:
This Cao Bang motorbike tour takes you from Hanoi to the far north-east of Vietnam by overnight sleeper bus, then on a full day of riding through the karst valleys of the Cao Bang Geopark. You visit Ban Gioc Waterfall on the Vietnam – China border, walk through Nguom Ngao Cave, ride into the remote Ngoc Con Valley and stop at Truc Lam Pagoda before the night bus brings you back to Hanoi.
## Highlights of the Cao Bang motorbike tour
- Ban Gioc Waterfall: the majestic falls that stretch along the border between Vietnam and China, one of the most magnificent natural sights in the country.
- Nguom Ngao Cave: a cave system filled with stalactites and stalagmites formed over millions of years.
- Ngoc Con Valley: a remote valley known for its unspoiled scenery and rich biodiversity.
- Truc Lam Pagoda: a sacred pagoda and a quiet place to pause at the end of the ride.
- Local food: breakfast at a homestay inside the Cao Bang Geopark and a lunch of local specialties.
- Easy logistics from Hanoi: you travel on a sleeper bus with private cabins on both nights, so the whole day is free for riding and sightseeing.
## What is included
TOUR PRICE INCLUDES:
- Shuttle from your hotel or accommodation in Hanoi

content:
This 15 days tour of Northern Vietnam links the main destinations of the north in a single trip that starts and ends in Hanoi.
## Highlights of the 15 days tour of Northern Vietnam
- Hanoi: a full-day city tour including Tran Quoc Pagoda and the Ho Chi Minh complex.
- Ha Long Bay: 3 days 2 nights on the Fantasea cruise, with Luon Cave and Titov Island.
- Sapa: 3 days 2 nights of trekking with one hotel night and one homestay night.

You may also like: 5 Day Vietnam Tour.
Hanoi, located on the banks of the Red River, is one of the most ancient capital in the world, where travelers can find well-preserved colonial buildings, ancient pagodas, temples and unique museums within the city center.
Ha Long is a city in Quang Ninh province, famous for Ha Long Bay – a World Natural Heritage recognized by UNESCO. The bay has thousands of beautiful limestone islands, is an attractive tourist destination with majestic natural scenery, entertainment and resort activities, attracting domestic and foreign tourists.
Sapa, located in Lao Cai province, is famous for its pristine natural beauty, cool climate and stunning terraced fields. It is also an attractive destination with diverse cultures of ethnic minorities, creating a unique combination of nature and culture.
Ha Giang, a border province in northern Vietnam, is famous for its majestic mountain landscapes, spectacular mountain passes and terraced fields. It is also famous for its ethnic minorities, unique culture and is an ideal destination for those who love to explore wild nature.
Ninh Binh, located in the North of Vietnam, is famous for its majestic natural landscapes, especially Trang An, Tam Coc and Cuc Phuong. It has limestone mountains, beautiful cave systems and historical and cultural relics, attracting tourists to explore.
Mai Chau, located in Hoa Binh province, is famous for its beautiful natural landscapes, lush green valleys and Thai villages. It attracts tourists with its fresh air, unique culture and sightseeing and discovery activities, making it ideal for eco-tourism and relaxation.

Lan Ha Bay is located to the southeast of Cat Ba Island in Hai Phong, Vietnam, and is part of the famous Ha Long Bay. The bay is home to over 300 small and large islands, surrounded by clear blue waters and pristine natural landscapes. With its white sandy beaches, crystal-clear waters, and unique caves, Lan Ha Bay attracts tourists with its peaceful and untouched beauty, offering a different experience from Ha Long Bay. It is an ideal destination for activities such as kayaking, swimming, snorkeling, and exploring fishing villages. Lan Ha Bay is recognized as one of the most appealing and promising tourist spots in northern Vietnam.

Lan Ha Bay, located to the east of Cat Ba Island in Hai Phong Province, stands out for several distinctive features and advantages compared to Ha Long Bay:
1. Less crowded: Unlike Ha Long Bay, Lan Ha Bay is less affected by heavy tourist traffic. This allows the bay to retain a more pristine and tranquil beauty, especially in areas that are less explored.
2. Diverse limestone islands: Lan Ha Bay is home to over 400 islands of various sizes, each with unique shapes, and covered with lush tropical vegetation. The islands here appear more natural and less commercialized compared to those in Ha Long Bay.
3. Pristine beaches: Lan Ha Bay features several beautiful, serene beaches, such as Cat Co Beach and Ba Trai Dao Beach, where visitors can enjoy swimming and relaxation without the crowds typical of Ha Long Bay.
4. Nature-centric activities: Visitors to Lan Ha Bay can engage in activities like kayaking, canoeing, swimming, or even trekking on the smaller islands. The bay remains relatively free from pollution and its natural environment is largely intact.
5. Connection to Cat Ba Island: Lan Ha Bay is easily accessible from Cat Ba Island, one of Vietnam’s top tourist destinations, known for its stunning landscapes and rich ecosystems.
In general, Lan Ha Bay is an ideal choice for those seeking a peaceful, unspoiled natural setting with fewer crowds, while Ha Long Bay is more famous and has more developed tourism infrastructure.

### Welcome To Ninh Binh!
When you think of breathtaking natural beauty and cultural treasures, Ninh Binh, Vietnam, is sure to come to mind. With breathtaking landscapes, unique experiences and seamless travel options, Ninh Binh has something for every traveler. This article will guide you through some of the must-visit places and experiences in Ninh Binh.
### Hoa Lư: Cố Đô
Hoa Lu was the capital of Vietnam from 968 to 1009. Located in Truong Yen Thuong village, Hoa Lu district, Ninh Binh province, Hoa Lu is one of the rice fields divided by limestone mountains, about 90 km south of Hanoi.
The ancient capital of Hoa Lu lies in a flat valley between small but steep limestone mountains that form almost impenetrable barriers to human traffic. Even today, many of the mountains are only accessible to the mountain goats that roam the area.

content:
This Ha Giang Loop 3 days 2 nights tour starts with an evening pick-up in Hanoi and a night transfer to Ha Giang City, then three days on the loop by motorbike.
## Highlights of the Ha Giang Loop 3 days 2 nights
- Day 1: KM 0, Bac Sum Slope, Quan Ba Heaven Gate, Tham Ma Slope and the Vuong family residence, ending in Dong Van.
- Day 2: Lung Cu Flagpole at the northernmost point of Vietnam, Ma Pi Leng Pass and the Nho Que River, ending in Meo Vac.
- Day 3: Meo Vac, Mau Due, Lung Tam and Quan Ba on the way back to Ha Giang.
- Sunday markets: the Dong Van and Meo Vac markets if your dates fall on a Sunday morning.
- After the ride: a Dao herbal foot soak at the Ha Giang office.
This Ha Giang Loop tour is a Ha Giang motorbike tour from Hanoi of 3 days and 2 nights on the loop. The Ha Giang tour visits Dong Van, Lung Cu, Ma Pi Leng Pass and Meo Vac, with bus transport from Hanoi and motorbike in Ha Giang.
